story:
SETS (make each one a cast member of kind "set" and give every shot the set of the place it shows):
1. The courtyard of a Hanoi tube house: a tiled yard with low stools, a charcoal stove and a big pot (kit place: garden); afternoon, night, dawn
2. The family's front room with the ancestor altar (kit place: living-room); dawn
3. Hanoi's old quarter rooftops under New Year's Eve fireworks (kit place: village); midnight

KEY OBJECT (the owner's notes — draw it exactly so): Bánh chưng: a flat SQUARE parcel wrapped in glossy green dong leaves with visible leaf texture (veins), tied with two pairs of thin pale bamboo strings each way (four strings crossing in a grid, NOT a ribbon, NO bow), a darker green leaf fold at the corners. ONE look only (owner 2026-10-12, D77): the wrapped parcel; the cooking is told by the pot and the fire in the courtyard sets. The front room has no altar drawn (owner + QC 2026-10-12, D78): in the LAST shot the bánh chưng sits on a small wooden table in the front room, in the centre, big enough to read — draw that table in the shot, do not change the set.

Chiều Ba Mươi Tết, bé An cùng bà gói bánh chưng trong sân nhà ở phố cổ Hà Nội. Bà trải lá dong xanh lên mâm, đong gạo nếp trắng, nhân đậu xanh và thịt. An học bà gấp lá thật vuông và buộc lạt tre thật chặt. Chiếc bánh đầu tiên An tự gói, bà khen vuông vắn như bánh của người lớn. Đêm xuống, nồi bánh sôi lục bục trên bếp lửa hồng giữa sân. Hai bà cháu ngồi canh nồi bánh, bà kể chuyện Lang Liêu dâng bánh cho vua Hùng. Bà chỉ chiếc bánh vuông như mặt đất, An tròn mắt lắng nghe. Đêm giao thừa, pháo hoa nở rực trên những mái ngói phố cổ. An ngủ gục trên vai bà, tay vẫn nắm sợi lạt tre. Sáng mùng Một, An mở mắt và chạy ra phòng khách. Trên bàn thờ là chiếc bánh chưng vuông vức đầu tiên do chính tay An gói.

bible.title: Bánh Chưng Tết: Lễ Hội Của Bé An
bible.logline: Chiều Ba Mươi Tết, bé An học gói bánh chưng cùng bà, qua đêm canh nồi nghe chuyện xưa, sáng mùng Một thức dậy thấy chiếc bánh đầu tiên trên bàn thờ.

cast.name: Sân nhà phố cổ
cast.look: Narrow tube house courtyard with tiled floor, low wooden stools, a charcoal stove with a big iron pot, brick walls, open sky

cast.name: Phòng khách bàn thờ
cast.look: Family front room with ancestor altar centered on main wall, brass incense burner, candle holders, fresh flowers, framed photograph, wooden floor

cast.name: Mái ngói phố cổ
cast.look: Hanoi old quarter rooftops with terracotta tiles, narrow alleys, night sky illuminated by fireworks

cast.name: Bé An
cast.look: Small child, round face, short black hair, wearing a simple áo bà ba in soft beige, bare feet

cast.name: Bà
cast.look: Elderly woman, gentle smile, silver hair in a bun, wearing a dark áo dài with subtle floral pattern, hands wrinkled

cast.name: Bánh chưng
cast.look: Flat square parcel wrapped in glossy green dong leaves with visible veins, tied with four thin pale bamboo strings in a grid, darker green leaf folds at corners

parts.look: flat square block about as thick as a thumb, wrapped tight in whole leaves, edges sharp and corners folded to points
glossy bright green leaf sheets covering all faces, clear vein lines running lengthwise, darker green triangular folds tucked at each corner
four thin pale bamboo strips, two running left–right and two front–back, crossing in a neat grid on top and bottom, no bow or knot visible
darker green leaf tips folded into sharp triangles at the four corners, tucked under the grid strings

shots.scene: Chiều Ba Mươi Tết - Sân nhà
shots.description: Wide establishing shot of the tube house courtyard in golden afternoon light. Grandma sits on a low stool spreading dong leaves on a tray; little An stands beside her, bare feet on tiles, the charcoal stove and big iron pot behind them. Brick walls frame the open sky.
shots.dialogue: Chiều Ba Mươi Tết, bé An cùng bà gói bánh chưng trong sân nhà ở phố cổ Hà Nội.

shots.scene: Chiều Ba Mươi Tết - Sân nhà
shots.description: Medium shot from the side, afternoon light slanting across the tray. Grandma's wrinkled hands layer white glutinous rice, green mung bean paste, and seasoned pork onto glossy dong leaves; leaf veins catch the light. An watches from knee height.
shots.dialogue: Bà trải lá dong xanh lên mâm, đong gạo nếp trắng, nhân đậu xanh và thịt.

shots.scene: Chiều Ba Mươi Tết - Sân nhà
shots.description: Low angle over Grandma's shoulder, afternoon glow. An's small hands mimic Grandma: folding leaf corners into a sharp square, then pulling pale bamboo strings tight in a grid. The first wrapped parcel takes shape on the tray.
shots.dialogue: An học bà gấp lá thật vuông và buộc lạt tre thật chặt.

shots.scene: Chiều Ba Mươi Tết - Sân nhà
shots.description: Close-up on the finished square parcel in An's cupped hands, leaf texture and bamboo grid crisp in afternoon sun. Grandma's finger taps the corner; her eyes crinkle with pride. An beams, chest puffed.
shots.dialogue: Chiếc bánh đầu tiên An tự gói, bà khen vuông vắn như bánh của người lớn.

shots.description: Wide shot of the courtyard at night, lantern glow and charcoal fire painting the tiles orange. The big iron pot boils vigorously, steam rising. Grandma and An sit on stools on either side, silhouettes cosy against the flame.
shots.dialogue: Đêm xuống, nồi bánh sôi lục bục trên bếp lửa hồng giữa sân.

shots.description: Medium two-shot, firelight dancing on their faces. Grandma leans forward, voice low, telling the legend of Lang Liêu offering square and round cakes to King Hùng. An's eyes grow round, head tilted toward her.
shots.dialogue: Hai bà cháu ngồi canh nồi bánh, bà kể chuyện Lang Liêu dâng bánh cho vua Hùng.

shots.description: Close-up on Grandma's finger pointing at a square wrapped parcel resting on the stool's edge — square like the earth. An's face fills the other half of frame, eyes wide, breath held. Firelight flickers on the leaf veins.
shots.dialogue: Bà chỉ chiếc bánh vuông như mặt đất, An tròn mắt lắng nghe.

shots.description: Wide establishing shot of Hanoi old quarter rooftops at midnight. Terracotta tiles stretch into darkness, narrow alleys below. Fireworks burst overhead — red, gold, green — painting the tiles and two small figures on a rooftop terrace.
shots.dialogue: Đêm giao thừa, pháo hoa nở rực trên những mái ngói phố cổ.

shots.description: Close-up, fireworks reflected in An's drowsy eyes. Head rests on Grandma's lap, one tiny fist still curled around a pale bamboo string from the wrapping. Grandma's hand strokes the child's hair, silver bun glowing in the bursts.
shots.dialogue: An ngủ gục trên vai bà, tay vẫn nắm sợi lạt tre.

shots.description: Pan following An's bare feet pattering across the tiled hallway at dawn, pale blue light seeping through courtyard doors. The child dong. Grandma's silhouette fades behind as An darts toward the front room entrance.
shots.dialogue: Sáng mùng Một, An mở mắt và chạy ra phòng khách.

shots.description: Close-up insert on the small wooden table centred in the front room, dawn light pooling on its surface. The square wrapped parcel sits alone — glossy green leaves, visible veins, bamboo grid, dark corner folds. No altar drawn. The first cake An wrapped, offered to ancestors.
shots.dialogue: Trên bàn thờ là chiếc bánh chưng vuông vức đầu tiên do chính tay An gói.

references.note: Courtyard of a Hanoi tube house with tiled yard, low stools, charcoal stove, big pot, and bánh chưng wrapped in glossy green dong leaves tied with four thin pale bamboo strings in a grid pattern, visible leaf veins, darker green leaf fold at corners; set for night, dawn, and afternoon shots
references.title: Tube House Typology in Vietnam

references.note: Front room of Hanoi tube house with ancestor altar placed on central wall facing entrance, featuring brass incense burner, candle holders, fresh flowers, and photograph; altar occupies most honored position in main room
references.title: Ancestor worship in Vietnam: altars, rituals and what travelers should know | Vietnam Tourism

references.note: Rooftop of Hanoi's old quarter under New Year's Eve fireworks at midnight, showing dense urban fabric and fireworks illuminating the sky above narrow streets
references.title: The "Tube House": Why Vietnam’s Buildings Are Tall and Skinny

references.note: Bánh chưng: flat square parcel wrapped in glossy green dong leaves with visible leaf texture (veins), tied with four thin pale bamboo strings crossing in a grid, darker green leaf fold at corners; drawn exactly as described in owner's notes
references.title: Tube House Typology in Vietnam

references.note: Small wooden table in front room centre, big enough to read, placed in front room set for final shot where bánh chưng sits; no ancestor altar drawn in this shot
references.title: Tube House Typology in Vietnam

references.note: Traditional Vietnamese tube house characteristics: narrow front (often 4m wide), deep interior extending into street block, long hallways, internal courtyards for ventilation and light, brick construction for thermal performance and economy
